content:
linter.style.header is included in linter.mathlibStandardSet, the linter set intended for projects depending on Mathlib. However, it appears that this linter is specifically looking for Mathlib.lean, which I think means it will always silently exit early outside Mathlib. (Please correct me if I'm wrong, but this appears to be the case for CSLib)

There's a bit of surrounding complexity, but I think that it boils down to replacing the hardcoded file path with something like what mk_all does. Does this seem like a welcome change?
Yes, I think changes that make our linters more usable for downstream projects are very welcome!
I'm happy to review such a PR (when I'm back from my travels)
